upright.text_en: Imitation, as, for example, sham fight, but also the strenuous competition and struggle of the search after riches and fortune. In this sense it connects with the battle of life. Hence some attributions say that it is a card of gold, gain, opulence.

additional_reversed.text_en: Quarrels may be turned to advantage.

upright.text_ja: 模倣、たとえば模擬戦のようなもの、しかしまた富や幸運を求める激しい競争と闘争。この意味で、人生の戦いと結びつく。そのため、ある解釈では金、利益、豊かさのカードとされる。
